output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_completed_order
FROM marts.dim_customers c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM marts.fct_orders o
  WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    AND o.status = 'completed'
);
output.explanation: The query counts every customer in marts.dim_customers who has no order in marts.fct_orders with status 'completed'. That includes customers who never ordered at all and customers whose orders all have some other status, such as cancelled or pending. I assumed the status column stores completed orders as the lowercase value 'completed'. The value list wasn't given, so check it against the data. If "completed" should mean orders that count as revenue, filter on o.is_revenue = true instead.
